//: Lighthouse CI for the Sigmatec Operations App (QA gate 4).
Mobile preset, on index.html?login=0&sb=0 — the same mock-mode URL the Playwright suite
uses, so the measurement is of the app and not of a Supabase round trip.
Thresholds are BINDING (phased-execution plan): performance >= 85, accessibility >= 95,
best-practices >= 95. They are never lowered to make a run pass; a page that cannot reach
them gets its numbers and its top causes written into the report instead.
Run: npm run qa -- --only lighthouse   (or: npx lhci autorun --config qa/lighthouse/lighthouserc.json)
Three runs, median reported — a single cold run on a laptop is noise.
